measured_blocker: Failed deterministic jobs outreturn successful paired fixed retries in 10/19 solvable requests. Ending the job removes positive future reward.
change: Add ideal remaining-horizon reward credit once upon completed dwell. No credit for merely seeing the upstream success predicate or any failed outcome.
upper_bound_derivation: Proximity maxima 1/6 + 1/4 + 1/2, plus engagement 1 and upstream success 1. Every other resolved reward term is nonpositive.
notification: Deliver the equivalent credit at ceil(native_terminal_step/8); align discount for exact versus partial control termination.

acceptance: Exact v2 physical, action, sensor and terminal-outcome trace parity in every arm
Only completed dwell receives credit; zero credit in all absorbing slots
All 19 matched scripted completions outreturn their deterministic failures after correction

scope_and_limitations: This is a reward correction, not a new task or a claim of observed post-completion force-safe behavior.
Credit is an algebraic ideal absorbing-success value; no extra simulated success, dwell, or recovery is counted.
The correction removes the observed early-completion penalty; it does not prove all successful trajectories outrank all failures.
All future learning comparisons must share this correction, architecture, fault support, force criteria, and charged cost.
No reuse of old pilot weights for the planned longer training; controls alone use the frozen old checkpoint.
